body:
# MineCrops
MineCrops is a lightweight server-friendly mod that protects crops and makes harvesting smoother by automatically replanting when you harvest.

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98b374cfd54efa3e75b4bd646261da296af80dcb_0.webp)

## Features
No crop trampling
Farmland will not turn into dirt when players jump/fall on it (applies to everyone, including the owner).

### Auto-replant on harvest (mature crops only)

When you break a fully grown crop, MineCrops drops the normal loot and replants the crop at age 0.

It consumes 1 seed/item from your inventory (or the equivalent item that places that crop).
If you don’t have seeds, it falls back to vanilla behavior.

![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff0133944afa1a2d1b83c8c5048146523bf5bdc8_0.webp)

## Spam-harvest safe
Prevents accidentally breaking freshly replanted crops when harvesting quickly.

## Mod crop compatible
Works with many modded crops by detecting their growth property automatically.

## Controls / How to use
Normal harvest: break the crop as usual (no Shift needed).

Remove a crop intentionally: Sneak (Shift) + break to bypass auto-replant and allow removal.
Compatibility (GuardStone)

## MineCrops respects GuardStone protection:

If GuardStone prevents a player from breaking crops in a protected area, MineCrops will not bypass it.

Owners/whitelisted players (allowed by GuardStone) will get the auto-replant behavior.

### Requirements
Minecraft 1.20.1
Forge 47.x
Java 17

## Notes
Designed for both singleplayer and dedicated servers.
Works best when you keep at least some seeds in your inventory while harvesting.
